title: Real-Configuration Engine contract and integration qualification
summary: Qualified bounded interconnect behaviors with parameterized real-engine cases and explicit negative/failure-path checks.

dates.note: Date identifies the recorded passing baseline, not the start or duration of qualification-infrastructure implementation.

facts.text: The September 4, 2026 ia-mcp baseline records 92 passing certified-live contract/integration cases against the real Configuration Engine.
The 92 cases expand from 28 test functions across nine files, covering NCI/CMN construction, CCG/MCN behavior, domains, memory-region parameters and parameter schemas.

Qualification includes invalid-input rejection, unsupported-product handling, failure recovery, checkpoint restoration, export and replay; a passing case may prove safe rejection rather than successful construction.
The separate historical full suite records 5,063 passing non-live tests, with overlapping fast, contract, security and packaging tiers.

The repository completion report preserves the September 2026 baseline as separate non-live suite, real-engine contract/integration, bounded agent evaluation and rollback evidence; this research inspected records and definitions without rerunning employer tests.

notes: No employer tests were executed by this repository migration. The reporting source inspected current code and the historical baseline without rerunning the suite.
92 cases are not 92 Codex prompts or independent agent tasks. Overlapping tier counts must not be added together.
Current source assets and September 2026 recorded passes are distinct evidence.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
